title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Adjusting the Standards for Jurisdiction over First-Instance Intellectual Property Civil Cases in Local People's Courts at All Levels
keywords_en: Jurisdiction; Intellectual property; Jurisdiction over first-instance intellectual property civil cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Adjusting the Standards for Jurisdiction over First Instance Intellectual Property Civil Cases by Local People's Courts at All Levels

Fa Fa [2010] No. 5

To: All Higher People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to further strengthen the intellectual property trial supervision and operational guidance functions of the Supreme People's Court and the Higher People's Courts, and to reasonably and evenly distribute the workload of people's courts at all levels, and based on the actual situation of people's courts implementing the amended Civil Procedure Law in the trial of intellectual property civil cases, the notice on adjusting the standards for jurisdiction over first instance intellectual property civil cases by local people's courts at all levels is hereby given as follows:

1. Higher People's Courts shall have jurisdiction over first instance intellectual property civil cases with an amount in controversy of RMB 200 million or more, as well as first instance intellectual property civil cases with an amount in controversy of RMB 100 million or more where the domicile of one party is not within their jurisdiction, or which involve foreign, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan elements.

2. For first instance intellectual property civil cases falling below the standards set forth in Item 1 of this Notice, unless they are under the jurisdiction of a basic people's court designated by the Supreme People's Court with jurisdiction over general intellectual property civil cases, they shall be under the jurisdiction of an intermediate people's court.

3. A basic people's court designated by the Supreme People's Court with jurisdiction over general intellectual property civil cases may have jurisdiction over first instance general intellectual property civil cases with an amount in controversy of RMB 500,000 or less, as well as first instance general intellectual property civil cases with an amount in controversy between RMB 500,000 and RMB 1,000,000 where the domiciles of all parties are within the jurisdiction of the higher people's court or intermediate people's court to which it is subordinate. The specific standards shall be determined by the relevant higher people's court and submitted to the Supreme People's Court for approval.

4. For intellectual property civil cases that are major, difficult, novel, or of general significance in the application of law, the higher people's court may, in accordance with the provisions of Article 39 of the Civil Procedure Law, decide on its own to hear the case, or decide to hear the case upon the request of the lower people's court.

5. For special types of first instance intellectual property civil cases, such as disputes over patents, new plant varieties, integrated circuit layout designs, disputes involving the recognition of well-known trademarks, and monopoly disputes, the determination of jurisdiction shall also comply with the special provisions of the Supreme People's Court concerning the jurisdiction over the aforementioned cases.

6. The standards for jurisdiction over first instance intellectual property civil cases within the military by military courts shall be implemented by reference to the standards of the local people's court at the same level.

7. After the issuance of this Notice, if there is a need to newly designate a basic people's court with jurisdiction over general intellectual property civil cases, the relevant higher people's court shall submit the standards for the jurisdiction of that basic people's court over first instance general intellectual property civil cases to the Supreme People's Court for approval.

8. The term "or more" as used in this Notice includes the figure itself, and the term "or less" does not include the figure itself.

9. This Notice shall take effect on February 1, 2010. Cases already accepted before that date shall continue to be handled in accordance with the original standards of each locality.

Any problems encountered during the implementation of this Notice shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court.

January 28, 2010
